record.bible_text: Thus hath the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> shewed<WH07200><WTH8689> unto me; and, behold, he formed<WH03335><WTH8802> grasshoppers<WH01462> in the beginning<WH08462> of the shooting up<WH05927><WTH8800> of the latter growth<WH03954>; and, lo, <FI>it was<Fi> the latter growth<WH03954> after<WH0310> the king's<WH04428> mowings<WH01488>. <RF>grasshoppers: or, green worms<Rf>

And it came to pass, <FI>that<Fi> when they had made an end<WH03615><WTH8765> of eating<WH0398><WTH8800> the grass<WH06212> of the land<WH0776>, then I said<WH0559><WTH8799>, O Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, forgive<WH05545><WTH8798>, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob<WH03290> arise<WH06965><WTH8799>? for he <FI>is<Fi> small<WH06996>. <RF>by...: or, who of (or, for,) Jacob shall stand?<Rf>
The LORD<WH03068> repented<WH05162><WTH8738> for this: It shall not be, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>.

Thus hath the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> shewed<WH07200><WTH8689> unto me: and, behold, the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> called<WH07121><WTH8802> to contend<WH07378><WTH8800> by fire<WH0784>, and it devoured<WH0398><WTH8799> the great<WH07227> deep<WH08415>, and did eat up<WH0398><WTH8804> a part<WH02506>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> I, O Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, cease<WH02308><WTH8798>, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob<WH03290> arise<WH06965><WTH8799>? for he <FI>is<Fi> small<WH06996>. <RF>by...: or, who of (or, for,) Jacob shall stand?<Rf>
The LORD<WH03068> repented<WH05162><WTH8738> for this: This also shall not be, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.
Thus he shewed<WH07200><WTH8689> me: and, behold, the Lord<WH0136> stood<WH05324><WTH8737> upon a wall<WH02346> <FI>made<Fi> by a plumbline<WH0594>, with a plumbline<WH0594> in his hand<WH03027>.

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, Amos<WH05986>, what seest<WH07200><WTH8802> thou? And I said<WH0559><WTH8799>, A plumbline<WH0594>. Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> the Lord<WH0136>, Behold, I will set<WH07760><WTH8802> a plumbline<WH0594> in the midst<WH07130> of my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>: I will not again<WH03254><WTH8686> pass by<WH05674><WTH8800> them any more:

And the high places<WH01116> of Isaac<WH03446> shall be desolate<WH08074><WTH8738>, and the sanctuaries<WH04720> of Israel<WH03478> shall be laid waste<WH02717><WTH8799>; and I will rise<WH06965><WTH8804> against the house<WH01004> of Jeroboam<WH03379> with the sword<WH02719>.<CM>

Then Amaziah<WH0558> the priest<WH03548> of Bethel<WH01008> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> to Jeroboam<WH03379> king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Amos<WH05986> hath conspired<WH07194><WTH8804> against thee in the midst<WH07130> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>: the land<WH0776> is not able<WH03201><WTH8799> to bear<WH03557><WTH8687> all his words<WH01697>.

For thus Amos<WH05986> saith<WH0559><WTH8804>, Jeroboam<WH03379> shall die<WH04191><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>, and Israel<WH03478> shall surely<WH01540><WTH8800> be led away captive<WH01540><WTH8799> out of their own land<WH0127>.

Also Amaziah<WH0558> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Amos<WH05986>, O thou seer<WH02374>, go<WH03212><WTH8798>, flee thee away<WH01272><WTH8798> into the land<WH0776> of Judah<WH03063>, and there eat<WH0398><WTH8798> bread<WH03899>, and prophesy<WH05012><WTH8735> there:

But prophesy<WH05012><WTH8736> not again<WH03254><WTH8686> any more at Bethel<WH01008>: for it <FI>is<Fi> the king's<WH04428> chapel<WH04720>, and it <FI>is<Fi> the king's<WH04467> court<WH01004>. <RF>chapel: or, sanctuary<Rf> <RF>king's court: Heb. house of the kingdom<Rf>

Then answered<WH06030><WTH8799> Amos<WH05986>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> to Amaziah<WH0558>, I <FI>was<Fi> no prophet<WH05030>, neither <FI>was<Fi> I a prophet's<WH05030> son<WH01121>; but I <FI>was<Fi>  an herdman<WH0951>, and a gatherer<WH01103><WTH8802> of sycomore fruit<WH08256>: <RF>sycomore...: or, wild figs<Rf>

And the LORD<WH03068> took<WH03947><WTH8799> me as I followed<WH0310> the flock<WH06629>, and the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, Go<WH03212><WTH8798>, prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> unto my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>. <RF>as...: Heb. from behind<Rf>

Now therefore hear<WH08085><WTH8798> thou the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>: Thou sayest<WH0559><WTH8802>, Prophesy<WH05012><WTH8735> not against Israel<WH03478>, and drop<WH05197><WTH8686> not <FI>thy word<Fi> against the house<WH01004> of Isaac<WH03446>.

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Thy wife<WH0802> shall be an harlot<WH02181><WTH8799> in the city<WH05892>, and thy sons<WH01121> and thy daughters<WH01323> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>, and thy land<WH0127> shall be divided<WH02505><WTH8792> by line<WH02256>; and thou shalt die<WH04191><WTH8799> in<WH05921> a polluted<WH02931> land<WH0127>: and Israel<WH03478> shall surely<WH01540><WTH8800> go into captivity<WH01540><WTH8799> forth of his land<WH0127>.<CM>
